prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the STYLE, mood and characters of this whole clip ONLY: do NOT copy its camera angles or framing. Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame.

[START FRAME] The first frame of this clip is GIVEN as the start image: a camera pressed against the tunnel ceiling looking almost straight down, Mai small in the upper-centre running down the frame. KEEP EXACTLY its camera height, near top-down angle, framing, lens and dim lighting for the WHOLE clip; the camera never tilts up and never drops toward eye level.

[Generation Goal] 5 seconds, 1 continuous shot, no cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. A camera mounted TIGHT AGAINST THE CEILING of the tunnel inside the fantasy gate, lens pointing almost straight DOWN onto the floor: Mai runs VERY FAST along the path from the TOP of the frame DOWN toward the BOTTOM of the frame, seen from above, keeping the SAME size on screen the whole clip. The light is LOW: she is going deeper into the dark tunnel. Clean air around her: NO smoke, NO dust and NO mist trail behind her or under her feet.

[References] @Video1: style, world and this tunnel. @Image1: the INSIDE of the fantasy gate, this IS the location: a long, fairly NARROW cyan-teal tunnel whose walls and ceiling are made of dark twisted roots and cables, with many floating glowing white and pale-teal monitors drifting in the air along the walls; a path runs down its middle. @Image2 = MAI ONLY (design only, re-render in Mai's 3D style): girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar, a red neckerchief; navy pleated skirt; white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack.

[Style Lock] ONE single render style for every character and creature: exactly the premium stylized 3D CG look of @Video1 and of Mai as she appears in @Video1. The character reference images are DESIGN ONLY (face shape, hair, costume, colours, props); many of them are drawn in other styles (pencil sketch, watercolour, flat 2D, outlined illustration, paper texture): IGNORE their drawing style completely and never copy outlines, sketch lines, watercolour washes, flat shading or paper grain. Re-render every person as a 3D character from the same film as Mai: the same proportion system and stylisation (rounded soft volumes, slightly large expressive eyes with catchlights, small nose, simplified features), the same skin shading and subsurface warmth, the same cloth and hair materials, the same lighting response, film grain and level of detail. Adults stay adult proportions (7-7.5 heads) but share Mai's stylisation. Nobody may look like a different art style, a 2D drawing, a realistic human or a different film.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 1 person in this clip. Nobody else exists in this clip: no wolf, no villains, no other people, no animals.
1. Mai (@Image2): seen almost straight from above, about ONE SEVENTH of the frame height for the WHOLE clip, running very fast from the upper part of the frame down toward the bottom.

[Scale Lock, match @Video1] Mai is a small 11-year-old girl about 1.4 m tall (6-6.5 heads), at the same scale as in the tunnel shots of @Video1. The tunnel is NOT gigantic: about 4 m wide and about 3 times Mai's height to the ceiling; each floating monitor is about the size of Mai's upper body. Mai stays the SAME size on screen from the first to the last frame (about one seventh of the frame height, as in the start frame): she never starts as a tiny dot and never grows big; she always stands on the floor, never floating near the ceiling.

[No Blending] Mai (@Image2) keeps only her own school uniform and sky-blue backpack; nothing from the tunnel merges into her.

[Composition, LOCKED to the reference frame] CEILING camera: pressed right against the tunnel ceiling, about 4 m above the floor, looking DOWN at about 80 degrees (almost straight top-down), 28 mm: in the extreme FOREGROUND, out of focus, dark hanging roots and cables of the ceiling poke into the frame along the top edge and both side edges, showing the camera is AT the ceiling; below them the dark root-and-cable tunnel walls slope down along the LEFT and RIGHT sides of the frame like a dark vignette; the floor path runs down the centre of the frame, lit only DIMLY: a soft, faint teal glow far ahead at the top of the frame, getting darker toward the bottom. Floating monitors glow DIMLY along both walls, a few drifting in the air above the path. Mai (@Image2) is about ONE SEVENTH of the frame height, seen almost straight from above: mostly the top of her black bob, her shoulders and the straps of her sky-blue backpack, her arms and quick legs; she runs DOWN the frame, from the upper part of the path toward the bottom of the frame; the faint light far behind her throws a soft, faint shadow ahead of her down the frame. The air around her is clear.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered]
Shot 1 (0-5 s), 1 person visible (Mai, from the ceiling straight above): ONE fast backward glide of the camera ALONG THE CEILING (staying pressed against it, the foreground ceiling roots sliding past) at almost exactly Mai's speed, keeping the same almost top-down angle and the SAME distance, so Mai keeps the same size and only drifts slowly from the upper-centre of the frame (0 s) to the lower-centre (5 s). Mai is already running at full speed from the first frame: VERY FAST quick urgent steps, backpack and hair bouncing hard with each stride; the floor, cables and floating monitors stream FAST past on both sides from the bottom of the frame to the top, showing high speed; the tunnel grows darker around her as she goes deeper. Her feet touch a clean floor: no smoke, no dust, no mist kicked up anywhere.

[Running Style] Mai runs the way a small, delicate little girl runs: graceful, soft and light, a little prim, not sporty. Small, dainty, bouncy steps landing lightly almost on her toes, feet close together; her lower legs flick outward to the SIDES behind her with each step; knees close together; upper body upright, shoulders soft; elbows bent and tucked in at her waist, forearms a little out to the sides, hands loose and floppy at the wrist, fluttering side to side rather than forward and back; hips and shoulders sway gently; hair and skirt bounce softly with every little step; but VERY FAST now: rapid, urgent little steps at her top speed, a light girl running for her life, still not an athlete.

[Acting] Mai: frightened but determined, running as fast as she can, glancing back over her shoulder once. Classic animation principles: weight in each step, follow-through on her hair, skirt and backpack.

[Character Look] Mai's skin is fair and light as in the reference; the teal light only tints her rim.
[Expression] Not readable from this height; no screaming.

[Lighting] LOW-KEY and DIM: she is deep inside the tunnel; no strong light beam, no bright shaft; only a faint teal glow far behind her at the top of the frame and the dim, flickering glow of the floating monitors along the walls; Mai is softly lit by the monitors, readable but darker; deep shadows in the root walls; the bottom of the frame is darkest.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom). Child 6-6.5 heads tall. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: Mai's light quick footsteps echoing in the tunnel, her soft hurried breathing, the deep electric hum of the tunnel, fast whooshes of monitors rushing past, a low distant rumble. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] a bright light beam, a strong shaft or column of light, an overexposed bright path; Mai tiny at the start or growing big at the end, Mai floating in the air or near the ceiling, a gigantic tunnel; Mai running slowly; smoke, steam, mist, dust or a vapour trail behind Mai, under her feet or anywhere along the path; a white plume or column of smoke; the wolf, villains, other people; any text, letters, numbers, subtitles, timecode, captions, scene labels or logos anywhere, including on the monitors; faces on the monitors; Mai large or close to camera; an eye-level, low or only moderately high angle; a camera far below the ceiling; the camera dropping or tilting up during the shot; Mai running straight at the camera at eye level; Mai bigger than in the start frame; Mai running up the frame or away from the bottom edge; Mai's face in close view; slow motion, freeze frame; cuts or a second shot; mixed art styles, 2D or sketch-like characters, realistic photographic humans; athletic or sprinter running, pumping arms; hoodie, chibi; dark or grey skin; studio or film names.
